36: variable {α : Type*} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {μ : Measure α} {f : α → ℝ}
37: 
38: /-- Exponentially tilted measure. When `x ↦ exp (f x)` is integrable, `μ.tilted f` is the
39: probability measure with density with respect to `μ` proportional to `exp (f x)`. Otherwise it is 0.
40: -/
41: noncomputable
42: def Measure.tilted (μ : Measure α) (f : α → ℝ) : Measure α :=
43:   μ.withDensity (fun x ↦ ENNReal.ofReal (exp (f x) / ∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ))
44: 
45: @[simp]
46: lemma tilted_of_not_integrable (hf : ¬ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) : μ.tilted f = 0 := by
47:   rw [Measure.tilted, integral_undef hf]
48:   simp
49: 
50: @[simp]
51: lemma tilted_of_not_aemeasurable (hf : ¬ AEMeasurable f μ) : μ.tilted f = 0 := by
52:   refine tilted_of_not_integrable ?_
53:   suffices ¬ AEMeasurable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ by exact fun h ↦ this h.1.aemeasurable
54:   exact fun h ↦ hf (aemeasurable_of_aemeasurable_exp h)
